ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF); Ley 2010 de 2019 (AML/CFT reform and final-beneficiary definition); Decreto 1670 de 2020 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales); Resolución DIAN 164 de 2021 (UBO registration procedure); Superintendencia de Sociedades and Secretaría de Transparencia administrative directives; Circular Básica Jurídica of Superintendencia Financiera as applied to obliged entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each natural-person incorporator's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of country of origin or Colombian notary for certified copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the issuing country; for non-Hague jurisdictions, consular legalization through the Colombian embassy/consulate and Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or certificate of existence and representation for any corporate founder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chamber of Commerce of the registered domicile (Cámara de Comercio) or foreign company registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign certificates; direct Cámara validation for Colombia-issued certificates

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized special power of attorney for the incorporator's legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of grantor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague jurisdictions, express consular legalization by the Colombian consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record certificates of each founder and initial director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Policía Nacional de Colombia for residents; competent police/criminal records authority for non-residents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Foreign records: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; Colombian records: direct online verification at the registration filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Financial and credit background check of each founder and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian credit bureaus (CIFIN, Experian Colombia) or certified international credit-reporting agency
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy; Colombian reports require no apostille; foreign reports require apostille or consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all incorporators, shareholders, directors, officers and final beneficiaries against the OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian National Police and Fiscalía anti-money-laundering watch lists, and PEP databases; any PEP designation triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds analysis, and senior-compliance approval in accordance with FATF and Egmont Group expectations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - www.rues.org.co, operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for Bogotá domicile)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory names must be in Spanish or adapted to the Spanish Latin alphabet; only the 27 Spanish letters, including ñ and accented vowels, are accepted; foreign-language words must be transliterated and rendered in a pronounceable Spanish form; trademarks, symbols and graphic elements are excluded from the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects a proposed name through RUES, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same chamber within 10 business days; if the rejection is confirmed, a recurso de apelación may be filed with the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 5 business days; after exhaustion of administrative remedies, judicial review before the administrative courts is available. A 30-day name reservation may be renewed only by a new paid request and not as a matter of right.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is accepted for SAS corporate formalities and service of process, provided a physical Colombian address is designated and the virtual-office provider maintains a real local address for official notifications; nevertheless, for a licensed charitable endowment-management entity, the Superintendencia de Sociedades and the licensing ministry expect substantive physical presence, adequate records, and at least one responsible local officer, so a virtual office alone is not commercially prudent.

Notarial fees for incorporators' sworn statements and power-of-attorney notarization

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document legalization fee in accordance with the 1961 Hague Convention and administrative tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) via DIAN web portal

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory filing fee for final-beneficiary registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office service and domiciliation for year one

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for SAS and licensed-entity domiciliation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT pre-incorporation compliance programme design (policy, PEP/sanctions screening, UBO identification)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance consulting firm or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for launch-phase SARLAFT implementation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, Arts. 98–131); Law 1258 of 2008 (Simplify Corporation/S.A.S. regime, Arts. 1, 4, 5, 17–23); Regulatory Decree 1074 of 2015 (merchant registry rules); R.U.E.S. Resolution 071 of 2016
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil (via the Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES national portal)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Incorporation Instrument of the S.A.S.) submitted through the Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (FUR) with the accompanying RUT pre-registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital: Law 1258/2008, Art. 4 leaves the subscribed and paid-in capital to the free determination of the incorporators. No escrowed or blocked bank account is required for cash contributions; subscribed capital may be paid in cash, in kind or as future services, provided that the payment term does not exceed two (2) years from the date of registration in the Registro Mercantil. For ESAL/charitable recognition, assets must be irrevocably and permanently assigned to the philanthropic or scientific grant-making purpose.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 001
WHEREAS the incorporation deed of [Entity] S.A.S. has been registered before the Chamber of Commerce; and the shareholders have subscribed the initial capital;
IT IS RESOLVED:
1. To ratify the subscription, contribution and valuation of the subscribed shares as contained in the bylaws.
2. To adopt as registered office: Calle 100 No. 11-30, Bogotá D.C., Colombia.
3. To appoint the Legal Representative and the corporate Secretary, and to elect the Board of Directors for a one-year term; the Revisor Fiscal will be appointed if legal thresholds are exceeded.
4. To authorize the Legal Representative to open bank accounts, execute grant-management agreements, and complete the ESAL and RUT registrations before the DIAN.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Search and Reservation (Certificado de Homónimos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil (RUES online portal: www.rues.org.co or www.ccb.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name search request in the RUES system. The system reviews the national register of companies and trademarks to ensure there is no identical or confusingly similar denomination. Upon clearance, request a 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre' (homonym certificate), valid for 30 calendar days, and retain it for the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de búsqueda de nombre (online form)
Valid identification document of the applicant/incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the system identifies a homonym, the incorporator must immediately file a new request with a different distinctive expression; no administrative appeal lies, but the corrected search can be resubmitted the same day through RUES without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Private Incorporation Deed (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) for signature legalization; final submission to Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the S.A.S. by-laws in accordance with Law 1258/2008, Art. 5, including object (endowment management for philanthropic and scientific grants), capital, share classes, board structure and non-profit distribution clause. Each incorporator must sign the document; foreign shareholders acting by proxy must present apostilled powers of attorney. All signatures must be authenticated (reconocimiento de firma) before a Colombian notary. Attach the Formulario Único de Registro, the pre-RUT of DIAN, and the proof of the physical office address.
required_dossiers: Documento privado de constitución of the S.A.S. (bylaws and identification of incorporators)
Formulario Único de Registro (FUR) – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
Pre-RUT certificate issued by DIAN
Proof of address (lease agreement or ownership certificate for the registered office)
Certificado de búsqueda de nombre (homonym certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses authentication due to formal defects (missing pages, inconsistent identification), correct the document and re-present for a new signature session. If the Chamber later observes a defective clause, an explanatory or corrective act (saneamiento) must be executed and refiled within the term granted by the registry officer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registry Registration (Matrícula Mercantil), NIT Assignment and RUT Update
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) for RUT issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the RUES portal, attach the notarized incorporation instrument, pay the statutory registration tariff (approximately 0.7% over subscribed capital, subject to the minimum tariff), and await the electronic issuance of the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. The NIT (tax ID) is assigned automatically upon registration. Thereafter, update the RUT in the DIAN MUISCA platform to reflect the S.A.S. status and, where applicable, the Régimen Tributario Especial (ESAL) feature.
required_dossiers: Notarized Documento Privado de Constitución
FUR/RUES electronic forms with e-signatures
Pre-RUT (DIAN)
Receipt of payment of registration tariffs (derechos de inscripción)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an 'observación' or preventive suspension, execute the requested clarifications in a supplementary deed within 10 working days and refile via RUES. For RUT discrepancies, submit a rectification through the DIAN 'Actualización del RUT' procedure with the corrected supporting documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Special Tax Regime (ESAL) Registration and Charity Qualification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Oficina de Registro del Régimen Tributario Especial (MUISCA platform); Superintendencia de Sociedades (supervision of non-profit entities)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically file the ESAL registration through MUISCA, updating the RUT to indicate the special tax regime, and submit the statute comprising the mandatory non-profit clauses: irrevocable dedication to philanthropic/scientific purposes, prohibition of indirect profit distribution to incorporators, and asset transfer to another ESAL upon dissolution. Complete the annual 'Información Exógena' and file the special regime annual report in each fiscal year to maintain the tax-exempt status. This registration constitutes the formal operating permit for receiving tax-deductible grants and distributing endowment income.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument containing the ESAL/non-profit clauses
RUT update request (Form 061 or online MUISCA procedure)
Statutory declaration of the philanthropic/scientific purpose
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Description of the grant-making programs and redistribution rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN denies or delays the ESAL registration, submit a corrective application with amended statutes that eliminate any remaining profit-distribution or liquidation-distribution elements; if the denial is grounded on facts, file a 'recurso de reconsideración' before the DIAN fiscal counsel within 5 working days; alternatively, operate as a general-regime S.A.S. and petition for ESAL status once the compliance report is perfected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Foreign Grant Flow Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking institutions supervised by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; Banco de la República (foreign-exchange declaration regime)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: With the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued within 90 days) and the updated RUT, approach a commercial bank and complete KYC/UBO due diligence in accordance with the SARLAFT rules. Open a segregated trust or checking account for endowment funds and instruct the Legal Representative on SWIFT wire reception for international grants. For each inbound transfer exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent per month, execute the 'Declaración de Cambio' (Form 6) through the intermediary bank or through the Banco de la República's electronic system, designated by chapter 1 of Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (maximum 90 days old)
RUT with ESAL/S.A.S. status
Certified copy of the resolution appointing the Legal Representative
UBO declaration (shareholders owning 5% or more)
Obligación cambiaria / Declaración de cambio forms (Form 6) for international grants
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the KYC/UBO information, file corrected source-of-funds statements and a copy of the grant contract. If the exchange declaration is rejected or misstated, file a corrected Form 6, and if the deadline is missed, process the 'infracción cambiaria' regularization with the Banco de la República and the competent fiscal authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Formalization: First Board Resolution and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Shareholders' Meeting and Board of Directors of the S.A.S.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural meeting of the Shareholders' Assembly and the Board of Directors; record the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution in the corporate minutes book (Libro de Actas). Ratify the appointment of the Legal Representative, the corporate Secretary and, where mandatory under Art. 203 of the Commercial Code, the Revisor Fiscal. Delegate powers of attorney, approve the annual grant-making budget, and order the regular filing of minutes so that every amendment affecting the RUT or the register is duly recorded before the Chamber of Commerce.
required_dossiers: Draft Board Resolution No. 001
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Acceptance letters of the appointed officers and directors
Proof of share subscription payment (bank certificate or in-kind valuation report)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses to legalize the minutes for formal defects, prepare a clarifying and amending act (aclaración y enmienda) and obtain the signatures of all attending directors; if a director refuses to sign, record the fact in the minutes and reconvene to reconstitute the quorum.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades (Dirección de Inspección, Vigilancia y Control) and DIAN (Registro del Régimen Tributario Especial / ESAL); Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá as auxiliary license registry office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal con objeto de beneficencia privada (ESAL) – Registro en el RUT bajo el Régimen Tributario Especial; recognized as the statutory operating authorization for ISIC 6430 (grantmaking foundation) activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (SDA) – Bogotá D.C.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category IV: activities of endowment management and grant distribution are office-based and are not listed in the projects requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment under Decreto 1076 de 2015, Art. 2.2.2.3.2; therefore only a certificate of environmental exemption, basic sanitation registration and solid-waste hauler contract are required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-generated domestic wastewater to the municipal sewer must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 household discharge limits. Solid waste must be managed under a licensed public-waste collection agreement. Hazardous waste (electronic equipment, toner, batteries): small-generator registration with the SDA is required if monthly generation exceeds 10 kg; below that threshold, manifest-of-transport and chain-of-custody documentation still apply; VOC emissions from HVAC and office equipment are below the stationary source thresholds of Resolution 2254 of 2017.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Seguridad Humana y Prevención de Incendios issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for the registered office; structural load inspection certificate prepared by a licensed engineer or architect for the occupied building; workplace safety and occupational health clearance (SGSST) under Decree 1072 of 2015 and Resolution 0312 of 2019, including first-aid supplies, emergency evacuation plans and employee occupational-risk registration before an ARL; compatible land-use certificate (uso de suelo) from the Secretaría Distrital de Planeación permitting office-based philanthropic activities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic services via MUISCA and DIAN web services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a legal representative and tax agent resident in Colombia; obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by submitting the pre-registration form through the DIAN MUISCA portal using the foreign entity's incorporation documents and power of attorney; the SAS charter (documento privado or public deed) must be registered in the Cámara de Comercio; for VAT and withholding purposes, the entity must activate the 'Régimen Común'/responsible status, obtain an electronic signature certificate and the electronic invoicing authorization; no minimum capital is required for SAS formation. Non-resident owners may hold 100% of shares.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box regime; the SAS is irrevocably taxed as a Colombian income taxpayer. However, the entity may elect to be treated as a 'régimen tributario especial' (special tax regime) for philanthropic/charitable endowments if it meets the legal constitution and activity criteria. There are also controlled hybrid mismatch rules under Colombian tax law (Law 2277 of 2022) limiting deduction of payments characterized inconsistently abroad, but no elective hybrid classification is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Economic presence threshold: periodic taxable sales, services, or self-consumption exceeding 3,500 UVT (Unidad de Valor Tributario) per calendar year obliges registration as an IVA responsible party; for 2024, 1 UVT approximates COP 47,065, making the threshold approximately COP 164,727,500. Cross-border digital services and importers of tangible goods are subject to registration irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) is mandatory for all responsible VAT taxpayers; invoices must be transmitted in real-time to DIAN through authorized technology providers or direct API (web services) following the 8-digit event schema; generation, transmission, validation, and digital stamping (representación impresa de factura electrónica) are required; the system assigns a CUDE (Código Único de Documento Electrónico) and a VALIDATION_UNIQUE_ID; no physical clearance stamp is used, but DIAN performs automated cross-validation with customs and bank exchange filings for export claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods and services rendered to foreign residents are zero-rated for VAT under the law if the exporter is the seller and the final user is abroad; for the endowment manager, qualifying zero-rated services must relate to foreign-situated activities, such as grant administration for non-resident charities, foreign-sourced software services, or export-linked international services; the taxpayer must submit a monthly export declaration and may request VAT refund if the exporter holds periods with creditable VAT from inputs attributable to zero-rated exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Formulario de Declaración de Exportación (Formulario 494 or Export Declaration Single Administrative Document) duly accepted by DIAN customs
Cámara de Comercio / export registration and RUES data
Bill of Lading (Marine/Air/Freight) or postal consignment note
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Pago al Exterior) or bank wire confirmation evidencing collection of foreign currency
Incoterms and proof of physical exit for goods, or proof of contractual performance abroad for services
Matching documentation package maintained for at least 5 years for examination by DIAN/Foreign Trade authorities
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If legalization and repatriation of export proceeds do not occur within 180 calendar days (or extended under exchange regime rules), DIAN and the Central Bank may impose fines up to 2,000 UVT and demand the VAT zero-rate be clawed back retroactively, plus default interest and a penalty of up to 200% of the omitted tax for fraudulent claims; false export zero-rating documentation constitutes customs fraud with criminal sanctions, including imprisonment, asset freezing, and disqualification from tax benefits; charitable endowment grants must not be disguised as consideration to qualify as zero-rated services.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), administering the Colombian Foreign Exchange Regime (Estatuto Cambiario) jointly with the Minister of Finance (Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público), under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises the authorized intermediaries through which all regulated FX operations must be channelled.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating peso (COP) with broadly liberalized current-account convertibility and regulated capital-account convertibility. Foreign donations, endowment contributions and registered foreign investments may enter freely; however, any FX operation exceeding USD 10,000 (or COP equivalent) must be channelled through an authorized intermediary and reported on a sworn exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio). Capital contributions to the charitable S.A.S. endowment must be registered with Banco de la República within 12 months of disbursement to enable lawful repatriation of invested capital, dividends and final liquidation proceeds. Profit and dividend remittances are unrestricted once the relevant Colombian income tax and dividend withholding taxes have been paid and the investor has filed the corresponding exchange declaration; there is no arbitrary conversion quota or profit-remittance ceiling. Current payments for grants, scientific services and ordinary expenses are generally free of prior licensing but remain subject to the channelling and declaration thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The foundation does not engage in export trade and has no export surrender obligation. For entities that do export, the statutory rule in Colombia is the channelling—not forced conversion—of export proceeds: the full amount must be received through the Banco de la República's foreign exchange market within the regulatory term (generally 6 months from shipment, extendable to 12 months for deferred-payment exports approved by Banco de la República), and a sworn exchange declaration must be submitted at the receiving authorized intermediary. There is no statutory percentage surrender to the central bank. Any incidental FX earnings of the foundation (foreign dividends, interest, sale of investments) are current-account receipts and are freely repatriable provided they are channelled and declared similarly.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente for endowment inflows and grant disbursements
Capital Escrow Account — Cuenta de Depósito en Administración for corpus protection
Operational Account — Cuenta de Ahorros/Corriente with foreign-currency sub-account
Capital Escrow Account — Cuenta de Depósito Administrado for grant budgets
Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente with treasury and FX desk integration

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low-Medium feasibility. Colombian banking and e-money law reserves deposit-taking and payment services to licensed credit institutions and SEDPEs supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera; there is no passporting or licensing regime for offshore digital EMIs to act as primary local clearing rails. Platforms such as Wise, Payoneer, Mercury or Airwallex can be used only as auxiliary tools for low-value cross-border incidental flows, because every regulated FX flow above the USD 10,000 threshold must be channelled through an authorized intermediary with a sworn exchange declaration. The foundation's treasury design should therefore route the endowment corpus exclusively through local Tier-1 bank accounts, while a single well-documented virtual-account aggregator may be retained at the margin for international micro-grants, with monthly reconciliation and full audit trail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under SARLAFT (Superintendencia Financiera Circular on AML/FT risk management), banks may use remote/electronic onboarding for low-risk local clients, but in practice a Colombian corporate account for an S.A.S. charitable endowment with foreign trustees, donors or grant beneficiaries requires a compliance interview with the legal representative—either physically at the branch or through high-grade videoconference with biometric verification—plus an apostilled notarial certification of the company formation records and board resolution appointing the authorized signatories. If the statutory representative is a non-resident, the bank will normally require a local attorney-in-fact (apoderado) with a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, who must appear physically for signature verification; fully remote account opening without any physical touchpoint is rarely granted for non-resident controlled entities and should not be assumed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity of the charitable endowment (trust/foundation layers, multiple international donors)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated corporate by-laws and certificate of incorporation and legal representation, full beneficial-ownership disclosure in the Colombian Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) submitted to DIAN, organizational chart with all direct and indirect owners above 5%, audited financial statements for the last two fiscal years, and a board resolution describing the endowment's source and purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border grant distribution to foreign scientists and research institutions flagged by sanctions or terrorism-financing screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and adverse-media screening policies and results (OFAC/UN/EU lists), grantee due-diligence file (legal existence, bank account ownership, purpose of grant), grant agreement with enforceable charitable-use clauses, standard exclusion warranties, and a compliance attestation by the compliance officer recorded in the entity's SARLAFT manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregistered foreign investment / capital injection without Banco de la República registration
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio) submitted by the receiving authorized intermediary, the bank's certificate of FX channelling, and the duly filed Registro de Inversiones Internacionales with Banco de la República (including investment registration screen print) proving registration within the statutory 12-month term.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained or disproportionate endowment corpus (donation/gift without verifiable wealth origin)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Irrevocable donation deed or endowment agreement, source-of-wealth documentation of each material donor (e.g., audited accounts, asset declaration, tax clearance certificate of the donor jurisdiction), bank statement evidencing the inward wire, and an independent valuation when in-kind securities or intellectual property are contributed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or sensitive-profile exposure of trustees, donors or grant beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP and politically-exposed-person screening results for all relevant individuals, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declarations certified with documentary annexes, tax residence certificates, and where applicable a clear rationale for the charitable transaction with recorded approval by the foundation's compliance committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign donors must remit the endowment corpus via SWIFT MT103 (single credit transfer) or MT202 (bank-to-bank cover) in COP, USD or EUR to the foundation's current account at a Colombian authorized intermediary. For any incoming amount exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent, the receiving bank will require a sworn Declaración de Cambio categorizing the flow (e.g., international investment contribution, donation, or endowment capitalization), the underlying legal instrument (donation/endowment agreement or shareholders' contribution resolution), and the identification of the ultimate donor. The bank will execute the FX conversion to COP at the market rate or credit the foreign-currency account, and the investor/endowment must complete the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales at the Banco de la República within 12 months of the disbursement; the proof of this registration is the gateway for all future capital and yield repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Grant, scholarship and scientific-sponsorship outflows will ordinarily clear through SWIFT MT103 (cross-border credit transfer) to the beneficiary's verified bank account, using the appropriate reference to the grant agreement; when a local beneficiary holds only a Colombian account, an internal ACH (CENIC) transfer or a domestic clearing instruction will be used instead. For any acquisition of scientific equipment or services, the foundation may open an irrevocable commercial letter of credit at its issuing bank (SWIFT MT700) with settlement via MT103/202 upon compliant documents. Every outward transfer above USD 10,000 must be matched against a sworn exchange declaration identifying the current-account or capital-account nature (e.g., scientific services, royalties, grant disbursement), and evidenced in the foundation's operating and grant-making records; the intermediary will debit the foreign-currency account or sell COP at the market rate accordingly.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forwards — permitted for the hedging of endowment receivables, grant budget lines and repatriation flows through authorized intermediaries
COP/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) — permitted where physical delivery is impractical, settling the difference in COP through the authorized market
Vanilla FX options on COP/USD and COP/EUR — permitted for hedging-only mandates arising from the foundation's reinvestment and multi-currency grant programming
Cross-currency swaps (FX swaps and long-dated CCS) — permitted to match the currency profile of long-term endowment assets with the currency of scientific grant disbursements

Futures on COP/USD traded on recognized exchanges — permitted only through financial intermediaries licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera and with settlement through the Banco de la República clearing system

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; the statutory renewal window runs from 1 January to 31 March of the current year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a surcharge of up to 10% of the applicable renewal tariff; continued non-renewal may lead to administrative strike-off of the commercial registration and impairment of the entity's legal capacity to operate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' approval of financial statements and deposit of approved financial statements with the register (Estados Financieros and acta de aprobación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Registro Mercantil); approval is an internal governance obligation of the shareholders' meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The annual shareholders' meeting must approve the 31 December financial statements by 31 March of the following year; the approved statements and adoption minutes are deposited within the month following approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit statutory financial statements may be penalized by the Chamber, negatively affects the company's commercial standing, and may expose the company to enforcement action by DIAN for irregular accounting records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing window is set annually by DIAN; for calendar-year legal entities, the ordinary filing window is generally between 1 August and 1 October of the following year, depending on the tax identification number.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of 5% of the tax due under Article 641 of the Colombian Tax Code; incorrect filing carries formal sanctions of 10% to 20% of omitted tax, and persistent non-filing may lead to DIAN default assessment (liquidación de aforo).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exogenous tax information return (Información Exógena) covering shareholders, grant outflows, and third-party transactions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to the DIAN resolution for the relevant fiscal year; legal entities generally file within the June to September calendar window after year-end depending on the last digits of the tax identification number.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate filing exposes the entity to monetary fines under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code, indexed to UVT, plus adjustments to the assessed tax base.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual final beneficiary update (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), electronic RUBF channel
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation must be filed within the DIAN-prescribed RUBF calendar following the fiscal year-end; any transfer of shares or change in control requires an update within the applicable DIAN reporting window after the transaction.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission, late submission, or inaccurate RUBF reporting constitutes a formal tax infraction subject to progressive fines under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code and may affect the entity's standing before financial institutions, grantors, and commercial counterparts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian S.A.S. must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) or independent external auditor when its total assets or gross income exceed the statutory SMMLV-indexed thresholds applicable under commercial legislation and Decreto 2420 de 2015; common markers are 5,000 SMMLV of total assets and 3,000 SMMLV of gross revenues. For 2025, 5,000 SMMLV is approximately COP 7,117.5 million. A grant-endowment S.A.S. that receives or administers public-benefit or charitable endowment funds may also be required to present audited financial statements under its constitutive document, fund agreement, or the supervisory requirements of the grant authority.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian statutory accounting is IFRS-based under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decreto Único Reglamentario 2420 de 2015, as amended. Grupo 2 entities use Colombian NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs); Grupo 1 entities use full IFRS. Endowment and grant income is recognized under the corresponding NIIF section applying to non-exchange grants and restricted funds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For each annual confirmation, the S.A.S. must identify every individual or legal entity that directly or indirectly owns more than 5% of capital, exercises direct or indirect control, or holds voting rights in the endowment entity. A transfer of shares requires simultaneous update of the company's register of members and, where applicable, an update to the DIAN RUBF within the DIAN-prescribed deadline. The annual confirmation cannot replace the transaction-based update, and the company must ensure the Chamber of Commerce renewal declaration is consistent with the RUBF information.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Officer Appointments (Registro de Junta Directiva y Representantes)
Minute Book for General Shareholders' Meetings and Board Resolutions
General Ledger and Journal (Libro Mayor y Libro Diario) supporting statutory accounts

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 900 per year for professional registered-office or corporate-agent services, including domicile address, correspondence handling, and local compliance coordination.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - USD 3,500 per year for a certified independent audit of an endowment-management and grant-administering S.A.S. under NIIF para PYMES.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% general statutory CIT rate for taxable years 2023-2025 (Law 2277 of 2022); a significantly lower effective rate of 20% applies to taxable surplus if the entity is qualified under the Special Tax Regime for non-profit entities (Régimen Tributario Especial, ET Arts. 356-1 et seq.).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying charitable endowment entities (ESALs) are taxed at 20% on the taxable surplus, provided they are annually re-qualified by DIAN, file the informative return (Form 1732), and allocate their surplus and assets exclusively to the authorized charitable/scientific purposes. General offsets also include deductions for wages (150% payroll deduction under Art. 108 ET) and depreciation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_note: No year limit: tax losses (pérdidas fiscales) are carried forward indefinitely under ET Art. 147, but the annual offset is capped at 3% of the net fiscal equity (patrimonio líquido) at year-end preceding the offset period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 210 (Formulario 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios, Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas) via the DIAN MUISCA e-filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (with advance CIT installments payable during the year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Calendar-year taxpayers: filed between 7 August and 10 September of the following tax year, on the date assigned by DIAN Resolution to the last two digits of the NIT. Non-calendar fiscal years: filed within 3 months after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, company name, fiscal year, status under the RUT and special tax regime (ESAL) qualification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not file this return; the S.A.S. reports their identification in the beneficial ownership annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue: endowment income, capital gains on investment funds, interest, lease income and any donations received that are taxable (donations to ESALs without RTE qualification are taxable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gross income sourced from Colombia is reported by the local entity; no foreign nexus reporting required except for inbound cross-border services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenditures, salaries, depreciation and deductible charitable grants paid out for the statutory purpose (when made to qualified beneficiaries and documented).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions for fees paid to foreign related parties require proof of arm's length pricing and the applicable TP annex; otherwise disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renglones 103-110 (Rentas exentas / Ingresos no constitutivos de renta)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exempt income and non-taxable capital contributions, dividends received from Colombian companies, and legally authorized exemptions (Arts. 123-135 ET).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends distributed from this box may be subject to additional shareholder-level withholding, including the 10%/35% non-resident dividend WHT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after all exemptions and deductions; the basis for the 35% (or 20% ESAL) surcharge.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No external fact pattern; determine whether the entity's surplus is subject to the 35% rate or qualified RTE 20% rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT computed at the applicable rate (35% general; 20% RTE).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withhold and remit the 7.5% or 10% dividend WHT on distributions to non-resident shareholders as separately required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for withholding taxes suffered, advance CIT paid and foreign tax credits (if applicable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot credit personal expenses; foreign tax credits are not permitted at this entity's level for shareholder taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Renglones 200-280 (Saldo a pagar / saldo a favor)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance due or refund position after all credits and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a refund arises, DIAN may process it subject to pre-funding audit; the non-resident must provide their TRC on request for the offsetting of WHT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due for each full or partial month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax (ET Art. 641); where no tax is due, 1% of gross income subject to the statutory minimum; late payment adds moratory interest at the Banco de la República rate plus 50% and a monthly 0.23% default interest; inaccurate filing: up to 100% of the omitted tax as inexactness penalty (ET Art. 648).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 120 (Informe de Precios de Transferencia) via DIAN MUISCA.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed concurrently with the annual income return (deadline schedule by NIT digit, August-September following the tax year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification, type of taxpayer, threshold tests (gross income > 61,000 UVT; gross equity > 100,000 UVT).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The local S.A.S. reports all cross-border transactions with foreign related parties; the non-resident has no filing obligation in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregated value of transactions with foreign related parties by category (goods, services, loans, royalties).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transactions with non-resident shareholders, directors, and affiliated charities must be included even when not formally invoiced in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Arm's length method applied to each transaction category (CUP, resale, cost plus, TNMM, profit split).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Relief available under the DTA does not excuse documentation; local files must substantiate the method used and be supported by a benchmark analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Master/Local file availability statement and requirement confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The TRC of the non-resident related party and the documentation of its place of business should be retained to demonstrate economic substance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the TP return or documentation is subject to sanctions under ET Art. 651 (5% of the omitted transactions or payments, minimum 15 UVT) and ET Art. 260-11 allows transfer-pricing adjustments with a 100% accuracy penalty on the understated tax; interest accrues from the original due date.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1732 (Informe de Entidades sin Ánimo de Lucro – RTE) via DIAN MUISCA (only where RTE-qualified).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed in March of the following year (same deadlines as the income return under DIAN scheduling; institutions and their managers must remit by the income-tax return due date).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, RTE qualification number issued by DIAN, and corporate purpose (charitable/scientific endowment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign founders/beneficiaries must be disclosed; foreign grants received may be subject to source-based taxation if not used for the exempt purpose.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Surplus determined for the year, amounts earmarked for statutory purposes, amounts distributed or to be applied to the charitable mission.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Distributions to or for the benefit of the foundation's foreign founder or family members would disqualify the RTE and trigger full 35% taxation on the surplus plus withholding at 10% upon repatriation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of grants awarded and beneficiaries, with compliance documentation and application of funds.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Grants made to non-resident entities must be supported by service/project agreements and evidence that funds were used for the authorized purpose; otherwise they are reclassified as undeclared distributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file: up to 5% of the period's gross income penalty (ET Art. 641); loss of RTE qualification retroactively for five years, interest and fines of up to 20% of the undistributed surplus for misuse of funds.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders out of profits already taxed at the corporate level (Law 2277 of 2022 raised the rate from 5% to 10% for payments made from FY2023). Dividends paid out of net profits not previously subject to corporate tax (exempt income or non-taxable income) are subject to a 35% non-resident withholding (equivalent to the shareholder-level tax).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the tax administration of the treaty jurisdiction and deliver it to the Colombian withholding agent (the S.A.S.) before the payment is made. The agent must obtain and retain a copy of the TRC, evidence of beneficial ownership, and, where the treaty contains a limitation-on-benefits clause, a declaration of qualifying status, for at least five years. The reduced rate is applied at source on a self-assessment basis; no prior DIAN authorization is required. If excess withholding occurred, a refund claim may be filed with DIAN (taxpayer's action) within the two-year statute of limitations, based on the TRC and applicable treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical assistance/services paid to non-residents: 20% withholding (increased from 15% by Law 2277 of 2022); DTA rates: typically 10%-15% (e.g., Spain 10%, Canada 15%, South Korea 10%). Interest: 35% general statutory withholding; 15% where the creditor is a foreign registered financial institution extending an external loan; DTA rates: commonly 10% (e.g., Spain, Netherlands).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File when prior-year gross equity exceeds 100,000 UVT (COP 4,979.9 million in 2025) OR gross income exceeds 61,000 UVT (COP 3,037.7 million in 2025); taxpayers that meet these thresholds must also file Form 120 and the annual TP annex. Below the thresholds but with cross-border transactions with foreign related parties, only the information annex of Form 210 is required.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply Offshore Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). Substance is enforced through (i) the General Anti-Abuse Rule (ET Art. 869 'abuso en materia tributaria'), (ii) CFC rules (ET Arts. 882-885) attributing passive income of low-tax foreign affiliates, and (iii) the ESAL/RTE obligations: the foundation must have real staff, infrastructure, formal grant policies and pursue its charitable object, otherwise DIAN will disregard the charitable status, impose the 35% tax on accumulated surplus, and apply the 100% accuracy penalty (ET Art. 648).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting endowment income (interest, lease rentals, capital gains of the investment portfolio) from Form 210, or fabricating deductible grants to shell beneficiaries to reduce taxable surplus to zero.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 4 to 9 years where the amount evaded exceeds 250 legal monthly minimum wages (± COP 325 million in 2024) (Criminal Code Art. 434A); fines up to 100% of the evaded amount; restoration of the surplus at 35% plus a 100% inexactness penalty (ET Art. 648) and moratory interest, computed from the filing date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign the return are criminally liable; DIAN may order travel bans and passport seizure for tax arrears above 100,000 UVT; personal assets are attachable under solidarity liability (ET Art. 794) when the entity's assets were diverted to shareholders or related parties before the debt arose.
